user.title: NFC Reminders
user.description: What would you like to add?

menu_options.group: A group (several reminders marked done together)

reminder.title: Add a reminder
reminder.description: Name the chore and say how often it should be done.

data_description.remind_after: In the same unit. For example every 5 days, remind after 3: it shows as due soon and is in the overview from day 3, and is overdue from day 5.

group.title: Add a group
group.description: One tag, QR code or button for the group marks all of its reminders done. Each reminder keeps its own tag too.

tag.title: Choose its tag
tag.description: Scanning this tag (or its QR code) marks the reminder done.

menu_options.existing: Pick a tag Home Assistant already knows
menu_options.new_qr: Make a new QR code (no NFC tag needed)

scan.title: Scan the tag
scan.description: Scan the tag now with the Home Assistant app, then press Submit.

existing.title: Pick a tag
existing.description: Choose a tag from the list, or type a tag id.

error.name_exists: A reminder or group with this name already exists.
error.no_scan: No scan seen yet. Scan the tag with the Home Assistant app, then press Submit again.
error.remind_after_too_late: The reminder must come before it is due. Use a number smaller than Every.

abort.no_reminders: Add at least one reminder first, then make a group of them.

data.notify_on_scan: Also send a message when something is marked done

data_description.reminder_name: Renaming keeps the entity ids and history.
data_description.remind_after: In the same unit. From this point it shows as due soon and is in the overview. Leave empty for no heads-up.
data_description.tag_ids: You can pick a known tag or type a tag id. To mark several reminders with one tag, make a group instead.
data_description.times: 24-hour times separated by commas, for example 09:00, 14:00.
data_description.targets: Nothing is sent until at least one is chosen.

error.invalid_time: Use 24-hour times separated by commas, for example 09:00, 14:00.
error.name_exists: A reminder or group with this name already exists.
error.tag_required: It needs at least one tag.
error.members_required: A group needs at least one reminder.
error.remind_after_too_late: The reminder must come before it is due. Use a number smaller than Every.

no_notify_targets.title: NFC Reminders has nobody to notify
no_notify_targets.description: Overdue reminders are not being sent. Choose who gets them under Settings, Devices and services, NFC Reminders, Notifications, Configure.

mark_done.name: Mark done
mark_done.description: Marks one or more reminders done, the same as scanning their tag.

entity_id.name: Reminder or group
entity_id.description: Any entity of a reminder or group, for example its status sensor. A group marks all of its reminders.

when.name: When
when.description: When it was done. Leave empty for now.

create_qr_sheet.name: Create printable QR sheet
create_qr_sheet.description: Creates a link, valid for one hour, to a printable page with the QR code of every reminder and group.
